name: Chrysochampsa
isnote: PBDB and English Wikipedia place it in the Brachychampsini, a group the atlas has no clade for.
sum: Chrysochampsa is a monospecific caiman-line alligatoroid from the Early Eocene Golden Valley Formation of North Dakota.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: A fairly complete skull and other fossils from the Turtle Valley site, Golden Valley Formation, North Dakota (Estes 1988); catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: The skull and assorted other fossils.
biology: The sources consulted describe it among four contemporary crocodilians of the Early Eocene Climatic Optimum but give no direct evidence of its diet.
author: Estes 1988

sources.text: R. Estes. 1988. Lower vertebrates from the Golden Valley Formation, Early Eocene of North Dakota. Acta Zoologica Cracoviensia 31(20):541-562
